name_jp: インフロニア・ホールディングス
summary_en: Public tender offer by Sumitomi Mitsui Construction (subsidiary of INFRONEER Holdings) for all ordinary shares of Mitsui Sumitomo Road completed June 2, 2026. Tender settled April 28, 2026; acquired 8,848,998 shares representing 95.38% voting stake; remaining minority shares compulsorily acquired same date under Companies Act Article 179(1); target now wholly-owned subsidiary.
summary_jp: 三井住友建設による三井住建道路普通株式の公開買付け完了（2026年6月2日）。買付決済4月28日；8,848,998株取得（議決権95.38%）；会社法179条(1)に基づき少数株主株式を同日取得；完全子会社化達成。
